attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Indiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of Jan 1, 2024); result.in_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.in_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IN requires addback of out-of-state municipal bond interest acquired after 12/31/2011.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set in_result.state_additions = 0.0; if in_result.out_of_state_muni_interest != 0.0 then set in_result.state_additions = in_result.state_additions + in_result.out_of_state_muni_interest; endif set in_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if in_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set in_result.state_subtractions = in_result.state_subtractions + in_result.municipal_interest; endif if in_result.state_taxes_paid != 0.0 then set in_result.state_subtractions = in_result.state_subtractions + in_result.state_taxes_paid; endif add (("Indiana additions: $" + string value of (in_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (in_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /in_result.state_additions xdef { in_result.state_additions in_result.out_of_state_muni_interest f+ cvd /in_result.state_additions xdef } {} in_result.out_of_state_muni_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /in_result.state_subtractions xdef { in_result.state_subtractions in_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /in_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} in_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { in_result.state_subtractions in_result.state_taxes_paid f+ cvd /in_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} in_result.state_taxes_paid 0.0 f== not ifelse "Indiana additions: $" in_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat in_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Indiana corporate income tax. Applies Indiana flat rate (4.9%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.in_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Indiana corporate tax (flat rate 4.9%); Apply Indiana 4.9% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set in_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (in_result.apportioned_income + in_result.state_additions - in_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set in_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (in_result.taxable_income * in_result.corp_tax_rate - in_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set in_result.refund_or_owed = in_result.estimated_payments - in_result.tax_liability; add "Indiana taxable income: $" + string value of (in_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Indiana tax liability (4.9%): $" + string value of (in_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: in_result.apportioned_income in_result.state_additions f+ in_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /in_result.taxable_income xdef in_result.taxable_income in_result.corp_tax_rate fmul in_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /in_result.tax_liability xdef in_result.estimated_payments in_result.tax_liability f- cvd /in_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Indiana taxable income: $" in_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Indiana tax liability (4.9%): $" in_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
